description: This file defines the FractionFormatter class responsible for formatting numerical values as fractions, particularly in the context of spreadsheet styling and number formatting. It includes methods for converting decimal numbers into fraction strings based on specified formatting patterns.

classes.name: FractionFormatter
classes.description: A formatter class that converts numeric values into fraction representation according to specified formats in spreadsheet styling.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Converts a numeric value into a fraction string based on the provided format pattern.

methods.name: getDecimal
methods.description: Extracts the decimal part of a number as a string, used internally for fraction calculations.
